title: Day 25 — Running Median (Two Heaps)
prompt: We need the median of a stream of samples, updated on every new sample, without re-sorting the whole history each time. How would you design MedianFinder?

clarifications.answer: Odd count: the middle value. Even count: the average of the two middle values, as a float.
Calling median() before any add raises ValueError.
Aim for O(log n) per add and O(1) for median — no re-sorting.
Duplicates and negatives are normal; samples arrive in any order.
Two heaps: a max-heap for the lower half and a min-heap for the upper half, kept balanced in size.
Keep the halves' sizes within one of each other; after inserting, move an element across if they got unbalanced.

hints: Split the data into a lower half and an upper half. The median lives at the boundary between them.
Max-heap for the lower half, min-heap for the upper half. Keep |lower| == |upper| or |lower| == |upper| + 1.
add: push to one heap, pop its extreme into the other, then rebalance sizes. median: if lower is bigger, its top; else the average of the two tops.
